notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal difficulty, particularly for Stasis builds. DECATUR 02 is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying stacks of Frost Armor as per the Destiny Data Compendium. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. For Stasis synergy, in the first trait perk column Crystalline Corpsebloom procs on a kill to provide a 4s buff - kills with the buff active generate a Stasis seeker which travels 3m before spawning a large Stasis crystal - these are weapon-generated entities so can inherit damage buffs, and proc weapon traits and subclass fragments when shattered for AoE damage. In the second column, for more Stasis synergy Rimestealer generates ×2 stacks of Stasis Frost Armor on shattering a Stasis crystal or killing a frozen enemy. To work with the frame intrinsic, Circle of Life provides an additional ×1.25 damage boost for a refreshable 10s after rapidly healing allies. Otherwise, for straight damage there's Rampage which stacks up to ×3 on kills for max ×1.331 damage for a refreshable 5s, with the stacks decaying one at a time, Master of Arms to provide ×1.15 damage for 8s after a kill with any weapon, with a second stack of ×1.25 for 5s on any kills with the first stack active, or Redirection stores damage by hitting red bar adds, for 2 stacks per hit up to 30 stacks, for use against orange and yellow bar enemies for ×1.5 damage at two stacks consumed per shot. Aegis ranks the Carrion Munitions origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it has an internal counter based on weapon damage, and when this hits 100% an insectoid robot spawns which tracks enemies within 25m and explodes for 5m AoE damage. If you're interested, the name (like the rest of the Distortion weapons set) is derived from names tied to prominent shipping, transport, and logistics zones across the United States. Etymologically, it refers to Decatur, Illinois (or Decatur, Alabama), a major inland transit hub. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.
